cards.def:
The system of production, distribution, and consumption.
हिंदी: अर्थव्यवस्था

An increase in a country's output.
हिंदी: आर्थिक वृद्धि
examples: Economic Growth alone is not enough.

cards.def:
Improvement in living standards and welfare.
हिंदी: आर्थिक विकास

Progress in social and economic conditions.
हिंदी: विकास

A state of low economic progress.
हिंदी: अल्पविकास / पिछड़ापन

An economic model aimed at reducing environmental risks while fostering sustainable societal prosperity.
हिंदी: हरित अर्थव्यवस्था
examples: Transitioning to a green economy creates millions of new jobs in renewable energy.
The national budget allocated substantial subsidies to accelerate the green economy.
A robust green economy prioritizes clean industrial manufacturing and circular resources.
International banks provide preferential green loans to businesses advancing the green economy.

cards.def:
Improving people's well-being and capabilities.
हिंदी: मानव विकास
examples: Human Development measures health and education.

cards.def:
The total economic output of a nation divided equally among its entire resident population.
हिंदी: प्रति व्यक्ति उत्पादन
examples: Steady growth in per capita output is a key indicator of rising living standards.
Economists analyzed regional differences in industrial per capita output across provinces.
Investments in automation and education dramatically boosted national per capita output.
High population growth can outpace productivity, leading to stagnation in per capita output.

cards.def:
The negative balance that occurs when a government's total expenditure exceeds its total revenues.
हिंदी: राजकोषीय घाटा
examples: The finance ministry announced austerity measures to curb the ballooning fiscal deficit.
A high fiscal deficit often forces governments to issue long-term sovereign bonds.
Targeted public investments can stimulate growth even if they temporarily widen the fiscal deficit.
Credit rating agencies downgraded the sovereign rating due to an unmanageable fiscal deficit.

cards.def:
Total income earned by a nation's residents.
हिंदी: सकल राष्ट्रीय आय
examples: Gross National Income differs from GDP.
Gross National Income reflects income flows.

cards.def:
Average income per person.
हिंदी: प्रति व्यक्ति आय

Comparing currencies by buying power.
हिंदी: क्रय शक्ति समता
examples: Purchasing Power Parity reflects real income.
Purchasing Power Parity is useful globally.

cards.def:
The financial capacity of a currency to purchase a given quantity of goods and services.
हिंदी: क्रय शक्ति
examples: Persistent inflation steadily erodes the purchasing power of middle-class families.
Salaries must be adjusted periodically to maintain household purchasing power.
Purchasing power parity allows realistic economic comparisons between different countries.
A stronger domestic currency enhances the purchasing power of consumers buying imported goods.

cards.def:
A general fall in prices.
हिंदी: अपस्फीति / कीमतों में गिरावट

An economic condition characterized by stagnant growth, high unemployment, and high price inflation.
हिंदी: मंदी के साथ महँगाई
examples: Central bankers face extreme policy dilemmas when attempting to resolve stagflation.
The 1970s oil shocks triggered an unprecedented era of worldwide economic stagflation.
Cutting interest rates to fight unemployment during stagflation can worsen inflationary spirals.
Stagflation inflicts heavy economic pain by combining job scarcity with skyrocketing living costs.

cards.def:
A severe and prolonged recession.
हिंदी: महामंदी

Government use of taxes and spending.
हिंदी: राजकोषीय नीति

Central bank control of money and interest.
हिंदी: मौद्रिक नीति

A significant disparity between the monetary value of a nation's imports and its exports.
हिंदी: व्यापार असंतुलन
examples: The government introduced export incentives to correct the persistent bilateral trade imbalance.
A chronic trade imbalance can place severe downward pressure on domestic foreign exchange reserves.
Tariff negotiations were initiated to address the widening commercial trade imbalance.
Trade imbalance often reflects fundamental differences in national manufacturing capacity.

cards.def:
A compulsory payment to the government.
हिंदी: कर / टैक्स

A tax that rises with income.
हिंदी: प्रगतिशील कर

A tax that burdens the poor more.
हिंदी: प्रतिगामी कर

Illegal avoidance of taxes.
हिंदी: कर चोरी

Legal reduction of tax liability.
हिंदी: कर-बचाव / कानूनी तरीके से कर घटाना

The rapid movement of financial assets out of a country due to economic instability or political fear.
हिंदी: पूंजी पलायन
examples: Sudden currency devaluations triggered massive capital flight toward safe offshore havens.
The government introduced foreign exchange controls to prevent destabilizing capital flight.
Political turmoil and expropriation fears are the primary catalysts of rapid capital flight.
Capital flight deprives domestic developing industries of urgently needed investment liquidity.

cards.def:
A program for social support.
हिंदी: कल्याण योजना

Poverty so severe and extreme that a person lacks the absolute basic necessities of life.
हिंदी: अत्यंत दरिद्रता / बदहाली
examples: Emergency shelter networks protect vulnerable street populations from terminal destitution.
War and displacement pushed thousands of civilian families into acute destitution.
Social welfare pensions provide a critical safety net that prevents elderly destitution.
Charitable soup kitchens work to alleviate immediate hunger and visible destitution.

cards.def:
A wage level high enough to maintain a decent, healthy, and dignified standard of living.
हिंदी: जीवनयापन योग्य मज़दूरी
examples: Labor unions campaign vigorously for employers to pay a living wage rather than the minimum wage.
A living wage ensures that a full-time worker can afford housing, food, and healthcare.
Progressive corporations voluntarily adopted a living wage policy across their supply chains.
Paying a living wage boosts worker retention, job satisfaction, and overall productivity.

cards.def:
Severe lack of basic necessities.
हिंदी: अत्यधिक ग़रीबी
examples: Extreme Poverty is a moral crisis.

cards.def:
Poverty measured across many deprivations.
हिंदी: बहुआयामी ग़रीबी
examples: Multidimensional Poverty measures health and education.

cards.def:
The unequal distribution of economic wealth, financial assets, and opportunities among groups.
हिंदी: आर्थिक विषमता
examples: Widening economic disparity between rural and urban districts fuels mass youth migration.
Progressive income taxation is designed to moderate excessive economic disparity.
Unchecked economic disparity weakens democratic institutions and erodes social cohesion.
Scholars examine how unequal educational funding perpetuates generational economic disparity.

cards.def:
An extreme and unbalanced concentration of national assets in the hands of a small elite.
हिंदी: संपत्ति का असमान बँटवारा
examples: Reports highlighted the staggering wealth disproportion where the top one percent held half the capital.
Severe wealth disproportion distorts political decision-making and public policy priorities.
Inheritance taxes and capital gains levies are advocated to curb wealth disproportion.
Economic historians study the societal upheavals frequently caused by extreme wealth disproportion.

cards.def:
Unequal distribution of income.
हिंदी: आय असमानता

The extent to which an individual's economic status changes relative to that of their parents.
हिंदी: पीढ़ी-दर-पीढ़ी आर्थिक उन्नति
examples: High-quality public schooling is the most reliable engine of upward intergenerational mobility.
Societies with high intergenerational mobility offer realistic hope to children from poor backgrounds.
Studies revealed that family wealth still heavily determines intergenerational mobility rates.
Affordable higher education opens vital avenues for positive intergenerational mobility.

cards.def:
Work below one's skill level.
हिंदी: अल्प-रोज़गार / क्षमता से कम काम

Unregulated economic activity.
हिंदी: अनौपचारिक अर्थव्यवस्था

Regulated and taxed economic activity.
हिंदी: औपचारिक अर्थव्यवस्था

A privately owned small enterprise.
हिंदी: छोटा व्यवसाय

Small loans to the poor.
हिंदी: सूक्ष्म वित्त / छोटे ऋण

Access to financial services for all.
हिंदी: वित्तीय समावेशन

System for managing money and credit.
हिंदी: बैंकिंग

Development of industries.
हिंदी: औद्योगीकरण

Growth of cities and urban populations.
हिंदी: शहरीकरण

Growth benefiting all sections of society.
हिंदी: समावेशी विकास
examples: Inclusive Growth must be the goal.
